s.d: A firearm chambered for a .22-caliber rimfire cartridge.
x: Once I borrowed the boss’s .22 rifle, and getting a good ‘possie’ round a haystack, popped off a couple of chooks before they knew what had happened.
I would rather have a .22 than an axe or a club, that's for sure
